## 2. Stability (go criterion)

*Best→last drop ≥ 0.5* counts runs whose final inner-validation Sharpe is ≥ 0.5 below their best checkpoint. **Read it with care:** each inner score covers one year of data (standard error ≈ 1 Sharpe unit), so the best of ~20 checkpoints sits well above the true level even without any collapse. *Late drift* (mean inner Sharpe in the last quarter of training minus the second quarter, median over runs) is the noise-robust collapse measure. Outer selected/last = outer-validation Sharpe of the chosen checkpoint vs the final weights (diagnostic only, never used for selection).

| Config | Runs | Best ckpt at (median % of training) | Best→last drop ≥ 0.5 | Inner Sharpe best → last (median) | Late drift (median; share < −0.5) | Mean-Q range | Outer Sharpe selected / last (median) | Seed IQR within fold (median) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## 4. Reward components during training (median over runs of the mean per env step)

`pnl` = real net return; `cost` = real trading cost; `shadow` = extra training-only cost (cost_penalty_mult); `risk` = mean-variance penalty (vol units); `hold` = holding penalty; `reward` = the raw reward before normalisation. Returns and costs are fractions of capital per step.
